description: This is a Java source file defining the ExponentialDistribution class as part of the org.apache.commons.math3.distribution package. It implements the exponential distribution with methods for calculating density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and random sampling, along with distribution parameters.

classes.name: ExponentialDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the exponential distribution providing methods for computing density, cumulative probability, inverse, and sampling with customizable accuracy and mean parameter.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of this exponential distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the density function value at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Computes the logarithm of the density function at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function at a given value.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the cumulative distribution function for a given probability.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean, same as getMean().

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (always positive infinity).
